decision.observation: A NEW Scout is selected (3/3, MELEE 10). The Scout's selection ring is at ~0.49,0.47 (the lone unit on grass just south of Tenochtitlan). 'UNIT NEEDS ORDERS' persists. There seem to be multiple Scouts, and each right-click re-selects a fresh one with 3/3.

In Civ VI the Skip Turn is usually the last round button. Let me click the rightmost round button before the '!' dial at ~0.83,0.535.
decision.memory: Multiple scouts; each right-click reselects a fresh 3/3 scout. Use the Skip Turn command button.
